top_signals.title: Glencore Took $480 Million Provision on Radiant World Exposure
top_signals.summary: Glencore Plc took a provision of about $480 million on its exposure to Radiant World, the iron ore trader that is under pressure amid concerns it provided falsified documents to banks, according to people familiar with the matter.
